name: Salamander
summary: A serpentine elemental of fire that wields a flame spear and constricts foes.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: At the end of each of the salamander's turns, each creature of the salamander's choice in a 5-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} originating from the salamander takes {dmg:2d6:fire}.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The salamander makes two Flame Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Constrict.

actions.name: Flame Spear
actions.onHit: *Hit or Miss:* The spear magically returns to the salamander's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Constrict

save.targets: one Large or smaller creature the salamander can see within 10 feet

actions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=14}), and it has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the grapple ends.
